dod_check.notes: Hand-crafted multipart/form-data body with two parts: (1) text part 'metadata' = 'スノーオーカ-멀티파트-텍스트' (Korean UTF-8, ~26 bytes), (2) binary part 'payload' = 16,384 deterministic bytes ((i*31)%256). Servlet calls req.getPart('metadata') + req.getPart('payload') + req.getParts(). Test asserts: X-Echo-Text matches text value after base64 round-trip, X-Echo-Parts-Count == 2, X-Echo-Binary-Filename == payload.bin, X-Echo-Binary-Length == 16384, and full byte-for-byte equality of binary echo. F2 boundary (Part wrapper) exercised including getInputStream / getSubmittedFileName / getSize on disk-spooled parts.

MultipartConfigElement configured with fileSizeThreshold=128 forcing the 16 KiB binary part to spool to disk (file-backed Part). After request completes, test walks the configured multipart location dir and asserts no regular files remain (Tomcat removes spooled temp files at request lifecycle end). Test dir created via Files.createTempDirectory and deleted recursively in finally to keep system clean.
